drivingQuestion: May a master say to his slave: work for me and I will not sustain you?
outcomeNote: unit ends on the inference; its testing presumably follows in the next unit

segments.he: שֶׁאִם יִרְצֶה שֶׁלֹּא לָזוּן כּוּ׳: שָׁמְעַתְּ מִינַּהּ, יָכוֹל הָרַב לוֹמַר לָעֶבֶד: ״עֲשֵׂה עִמִּי וְאֵינִי זָנָךְ״?
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «As, if» the master «wishes not to sustain» his slave he is allowed to act accordingly. The Gemara comments: «Conclude from» the mishna that «the master is» legally «able to say to» his «slave: Work for me but I will not sustain you.»
